_doc: One factory (docs/plans/STUDIO_ONE_FACTORY.md). A technique is on the menu only when it is real: status 'ready' and, for kind 'code', a lib/studio module plus the test that holds it (ci:studio-techniques checks both exist). 'planned' techniques are ideas with a named home; video_gate refuses them in a brief. Categories feed video:check checks 15 and 16: every film needs one ready hook, scene and type technique, and its hook + scene set may not repeat any of the last five films. Every technique has a tier: 'signature' (the visible craft from the research) or 'base' (spine and polish); every film runs at least one ready signature technique (video_gate, the render preflight and check 15 refuse one that does not).

categories.hook: How the first 1 to 2 s stops the scroll.
categories.scene: The picture device that carries the story (a chart drawn on, a map, pins, footage moves).
categories.type: How words and numbers arrive and hold.
categories.transition: How one beat becomes the next, and the loop seam.
categories.cta: The topic call to action before the end card.
categories.footage: How real or Imagine footage is made or moved. Not a creative layer on its own.
categories.process: How the work is made and reviewed. Not a creative layer.
